# National Institutes of Health (NIH)
> Official website of the U.S. National Institutes of Health, providing health information, research news, funding resources, and institute-wide programs.

NIH is the federal focal point for medical and health research in the United States. This site connects the public, researchers, clinicians, educators, patients, and media with health information, grants and funding guidance, institute directories, news, and strategic initiatives.

## Main Site
- [NIH Home](https://www.nih.gov/): Main entry point for NIH news, health resources, institutes, and featured initiatives.
- [About NIH](https://www.nih.gov/about-nih): Overview of NIH mission, leadership, organization, and history.
- [NIH at a Glance](https://www.nih.gov/about-nih/what-we-do/nih-almanac/nih-at-a-glance): Summary of NIH structure, budget, workforce, and research scope.
- [Institutes, Centers, and Offices](https://www.nih.gov/institutes-nih): Directory of NIH institutes, centers, and offices.
- [Contact Us](https://www.nih.gov/about-nih/contact-us): Contact information for NIH offices, services, and general inquiries.
- [FAQs](https://www.nih.gov/about-nih/frequently-asked-questions): Answers to common questions about NIH programs, services, and operations.
- [Visitor Information](https://www.nih.gov/about-nih/visitor-information): Campus access, directions, security, and visitor guidance.
- [Virtual Tour](https://www.nih.gov/virtual-tour): Online tour of NIH campus, history, and facilities.

## Health Information
- [Health Information](https://www.nih.gov/health-information): Public health information, wellness resources, and disease-related materials from NIH.
- [NIH Clinical Research Trials and You](https://www.nih.gov/health-information/nih-clinical-research-trials-you): Plain-language information about clinical trials, participation, and research processes.
- [Your Healthiest Self: Wellness Toolkits](https://www.nih.gov/health-information/your-healthiest-self-wellness-toolkits): Practical wellness guides for healthy living across life stages.
- [Talking With Your Doctor or Health Care Provider](https://www.nih.gov/institutes-nih/office-communications-public-liaison/clear-communication/talking-your-doctor-or-health-care-provider): Communication tips for discussing symptoms, treatments, and care decisions.
- [En Español](https://salud.nih.gov/): Spanish-language NIH health information and educational resources.
- [MedlinePlus Health Information](https://medlineplus.gov/): Consumer health information on diseases, drugs, tests, and wellness topics.
- [NIH News in Health](https://newsinhealth.nih.gov/): Monthly consumer-friendly health news based on NIH research.
- [Science Education Resources](https://science.education.nih.gov/): Educational materials and activities for science teachers, students, and learners.

## Grants and Funding
- [Grants & Funding](https://www.nih.gov/grants-funding): NIH overview page for grants, contracts, and research funding resources.
- [Grants Home Page](https://grants.nih.gov/): Central hub for NIH grants policy, opportunities, and application guidance.
- [Find Funding](https://grants.nih.gov/funding/index.htm): Search and browse NIH funding opportunities and notices.
- [How to Apply](https://grants.nih.gov/grants/how-to-apply-application-guide.html): Step-by-step application instructions for NIH grant submissions.
- [Due Dates](https://grants.nih.gov/grants/how-to-apply-application-guide/due-dates-and-submission-policies/due-dates.htm): Standard due dates and submission policy information for applications.
- [New to NIH](https://grants.nih.gov/new-to-nih): Introductory guidance for investigators and organizations new to NIH funding.
- [Policy & Compliance](https://grants.nih.gov/grants/about_grants.htm): Grants policy, compliance requirements, and administration resources.
- [Contracts](https://grants.nih.gov/funding/contracts.htm): Information on NIH contract funding opportunities and acquisition processes.

## Research Training and Career Support
- [Loan Repayment Programs](https://www.lrp.nih.gov/): Programs that repay educational debt for qualified biomedical researchers.
- [Research Training and Career Development](https://researchtraining.nih.gov/): NIH-wide training, fellowship, and career development resources.
- [Office of Intramural Training & Education](https://www.training.nih.gov/): Training opportunities and career support for NIH intramural trainees.
- [Scientific Workforce Diversity](https://diversity.nih.gov/): Programs and resources supporting diversity in the biomedical workforce.
- [Common Fund](https://commonfund.nih.gov/): Cross-cutting NIH programs supporting transformative biomedical research.
- [All of Us Research Program](https://allofus.nih.gov/): Precision medicine research program building a diverse health data resource.

## News and Media
- [News & Events](https://www.nih.gov/news-events): NIH-wide news, announcements, events, and featured stories.
- [News Releases](https://www.nih.gov/news-events/news-releases): Official NIH press releases on research findings and agency updates.
- [Media Inquiries](https://www.nih.gov/news-events/media-inquiries): Contact information and guidance for journalists and media requests.
- [Press Room](https://www.nih.gov/press-room): Central press resources, statements, and media materials.
- [NIH on Social Media](https://www.nih.gov/news-events/nih-social-media): Official NIH social media channels and accounts.
- [NIH Research Matters](https://www.nih.gov/news-events/nih-research-matters): Short summaries of notable NIH-supported research advances.
- [Nexus](https://nexus.od.nih.gov/all/): NIH grants and policy blog with updates for the research community.
- [NIH Website Archives](https://www.nih.gov/nih-website-archives): Archived NIH web content from previous site versions.

## Clinical Research and Trials
- [NIH Clinical Center](https://clinicalcenter.nih.gov/): Research hospital information, patient resources, and clinical studies.
- [ClinicalTrials.gov](https://clinicaltrials.gov/): Registry and results database for publicly and privately supported clinical studies.
- [NIH Clinical Research Trials and You](https://www.nih.gov/health-information/nih-clinical-research-trials-you): Introductory resource for understanding and joining clinical research.
- [National Library of Medicine](https://www.nlm.nih.gov/): Biomedical library resources, databases, and health information services.
- [MedlinePlus](https://medlineplus.gov/): Patient-oriented medical information linked to conditions, treatments, and tests.

## Institutes, Centers, and Offices
- [Institutes and Centers Directory](https://www.nih.gov/institutes-nih/list-institutes-centers-offices): Full list of NIH institutes, centers, and offices.
- [National Cancer Institute (NCI)](https://www.cancer.gov/): Cancer research, clinical trials, and patient information.
- [National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute (NHLBI)](https://www.nhlbi.nih.gov/): Research and public resources on heart, lung, blood, and sleep disorders.
- [National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID)](https://www.niaid.nih.gov/): Research on infectious, immunologic, and allergic diseases.
- [National Institute of Mental Health (NIMH)](https://www.nimh.nih.gov/): Mental health research, publications, and clinical study information.
- [National Institute on Aging (NIA)](https://www.nia.nih.gov/): Aging research and health information for older adults.
- [National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases (NIDDK)](https://www.niddk.nih.gov/): Research and health information on diabetes and digestive, kidney diseases.
- [National Library of Medicine (NLM)](https://www.nlm.nih.gov/): NIH library and information services for biomedical literature and data.

## Strategic Initiatives and Programs
- [NIH-Wide Strategic Plan](https://www.nih.gov/about-nih/what-we-do/nih-almanac/nih-wide-strategic-plan): Agency-wide strategic priorities guiding NIH research and operations.
- [NIH Strategic Plan for Disability Health Research](https://www.nih.gov/health-information/nih-strategic-plan-disability-health-research): Strategic framework for advancing disability health research across NIH.
- [BRAIN Initiative](https://braininitiative.nih.gov/): NIH-led effort to accelerate neuroscience and brain technology research.
- [HEAL Initiative](https://heal.nih.gov/): Research initiative addressing pain management and opioid misuse.
- [RADx](https://www.nih.gov/research-training/medical-research-initiatives/radx): Rapid Acceleration of Diagnostics initiative for innovative testing technologies.
- [UNITE](https://www.nih.gov/ending-structural-racism/unite): NIH initiative to address structural racism in the biomedical enterprise.
- [Sex as a Biological Variable](https://orwh.od.nih.gov/sex-gender/nih-policy-sex-biological-variable): NIH policy and guidance on considering sex in research design.

## Public Engagement and Education
- [Science Education Resources](https://science.education.nih.gov/): Curriculum materials, activities, and educational tools for science learning.
- [National Human Genome Research Institute Education](https://www.genome.gov/For-Educators): Genomics education resources for teachers, students, and the public.
- [DNA Day](https://www.genome.gov/dna-day): Annual genomics education initiative with classroom and outreach resources.
- [Clear Communication](https://www.nih.gov/institutes-nih/office-communications-public-liaison/clear-communication): NIH plain-language and health communication resources.
- [Community Engagement Alliance (CEAL)](https://covid19community.nih.gov/): Community-focused outreach and engagement around health research participation.
